newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Two killed, 13 injured by lightning in Sri Lanka.
newsitem.headline: Two killed, 13 injured by lightning in Sri Lanka.

text.p: Two people were killed and 13 injured when they were struck by lightning in northern Sri Lanka, police said on Monday.

They said the people were harvesting the paddy crop in Thammannalavekka village, 24 km (15 miles) from Vavuniya town, when they were hit by lightning on Sunday. Vavuniya is about 250 km (155 miles) northeast of the capital of Colombo.
A home guard and a junior government official were killed, police said. Six of the injured were admitted to area hospitals in critical condition.
No other details were immediately available.
